//go:build js && wasm && nextgo_native_browser && !nextgo_module

package client

import (
 "syscall/js"
 "testing"
)

// SOURCE ONLY. This explicit future native-browser profile is UNADMITTED and
// UNRUN. Native capture and a controlled stock browser are mandatory profile
// preconditions; their absence fails rather than silently skips qualification.
func TestOfflineNativeActualClaimCannotBeConsumedTwice(t *testing.T) {
 if !offlineNativeReady() {t.Fatal("native-browser precondition: actual static startup claim missing")}
 if !checkedJSGet(js.Global(),"__nextgoOfflineNativeClaimV1").IsUndefined() {t.Fatal("claim slot survived actual package-init claim")}
 if claimOfflineNativeCapability().valid {t.Fatal("duplicate claim returned a second capability")}
 if !offlineNativeReady() {t.Fatal("missing duplicate claim changed held capability")}
}

func TestOfflineNativeCreateFrameBypassesActualDocumentOwnGetter(t *testing.T) {
 if !offlineNativeReady() {t.Fatal("native-browser precondition: actual startup native capture missing")}
 parentDocument:=checkedJSGet(js.Global(),"document")
 getterCalls:=0
 getter:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{getterCalls++;return js.Undefined()})
 defer getter.Release()
 descriptor:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"get":getter,"configurable":true})
 checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSReflection.defineProperty,parentDocument,"createElement",descriptor)
 defer checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSGet(checkedJSGet(js.Global(),"Reflect"),"deleteProperty"),parentDocument,"createElement")
 frame,err:=offlineNativeCreateFrame(parentDocument,"https://example.invalid/native-capture-helper")
 if err!=nil {t.Fatalf("native create failed: %v",err)}
 if getterCalls!=0 {t.Fatal("authored document createElement getter ran")}
 if checkedJSGet(frame,"nodeName").String()!="IFRAME" || !checkedJSGet(frame,"parentNode").IsNull() {t.Fatal("native preparation did not return an unused iframe")}
 if checkedJSGet(frame,"src").String()!="https://example.invalid/native-capture-helper" {t.Fatal("fixed native source was not prepared")}
}

func TestOfflineNativeFinalParentQueryBypassesActualOwnProperties(t *testing.T) {
 if !offlineNativeReady() {t.Fatal("native-browser precondition: actual startup native capture missing")}
 g:=js.Global();document:=checkedJSGet(g,"document")
 parent,err:=offlineNativeCaptureParent(g,document)
 if err!=nil {t.Fatal("native-browser precondition: actual controlled native parent missing")}
 // Get expected text from the native prototype getter before installing the
 // own shadow. The call being tested must bypass BOTH own property overrides.
 swPrototype:=checkedJSGet(checkedJSGet(g,"ServiceWorker"),"prototype")
 descriptor:=checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSGet(checkedJSGet(g,"Object"),"getOwnPropertyDescriptor"),swPrototype,"scriptURL")
 nativeURL:=checkedJSApply(checkedJSGet(descriptor,"get"),parent.Controller,checkedJSArray(nil)).String()
 calls:=0
 shadow:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{calls++;return "https://invalid.example/forged"})
 defer shadow.Release()
 own:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"get":shadow,"configurable":true})
 checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSReflection.defineProperty,parent.Controller,"scriptURL",own)
 checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSReflection.defineProperty,parent.Container,"getRegistrations",own)
 deleteProperty:=checkedJSGet(checkedJSGet(g,"Reflect"),"deleteProperty")
 defer checkedJSInvoke(deleteProperty,parent.Controller,"scriptURL")
 defer checkedJSInvoke(deleteProperty,parent.Container,"getRegistrations")
 authorizations:=0
 var call *offlineNativeCall
 authorize:=js.FuncOf(func(_ js.Value,args []js.Value)any{
  authorizations++
  return call!=nil && len(args)==3 && args[0].String()=="native-parent-property-negative" && args[1].Int()==int(offlineNativeParentListRetired) && args[2].Equal(call.ReceiptIdentity())
 })
 defer authorize.Release()
 input:=offlineNativeInput{Operation:offlineNativeParentListRetired,Nonce:"native-parent-property-negative",Authorize:authorize,
  Refs:offlineNativeRefs{ParentWindow:parent.Window,ParentDocument:parent.Document,ParentNavigator:parent.Navigator,ParentContainer:parent.Container,ParentController:parent.Controller,ParentLocation:parent.Location},
  Policy:offlineNativePolicy{Origin:parent.Origin,HelperURL:parent.Origin+"/_native-test-helper",WorkerURL:nativeURL,Scope:parent.Origin+"/"},
 }
 call,err=offlineNativePrepare(input);if err!=nil {t.Fatalf("prepare: %v",err)}
 receipt,err:=call.Invoke(authorize)
 if err!=nil || receipt.Reason!=offlineNativeReasonNone || !receipt.Entered || !receipt.Issued || !receipt.Returned {t.Fatalf("native query receipt: %+v, %v",receipt,err)}
 if calls!=0 || authorizations!=1 {t.Fatal("own getter ran or authorize was not exactly once")}
 if _,err:=call.Invoke(authorize);err==nil {t.Fatal("same native call replayed")}
 if authorizations!=1 || calls!=0 {t.Fatal("replay invoked a callback or getter")}
 // Native then acceptance and complete native inventory remain required.
 // Delivery from inside a callback is NOT an actual JS-wrapper-return receipt.
 // syscall/js permits Release while running, but that weaker guarantee cannot
 // establish this profile's stricter physical callback/native-reaction join.
 // TESTONLY quarantine uses one existing production cell layout, without linking
 // it to a realm or granting it any authority. No new pool/observer/ACK exists.
 // The callback registry roots closures which retain this cell, and the cell
 // retains both Func handles plus the actual Promise. No Release/unlink occurs.
 observer:=&offlineDisableNativeCell{promise:receipt.Value,charged:true,quarantined:true}
 delivered:=make(chan bool,1)
 observer.resolved=js.FuncOf(func(_ js.Value,args []js.Value)any{
  valid:=false
  if len(args)==1 {
   observer.value=args[0]
   _,inspectErr:=offlineNativeInspectInventory(args[0]);valid=inspectErr==nil
  }
  observer.terminal=true
  delivered<-valid;return nil
 });observer.resolvedOwned=true
 observer.rejected=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{
  observer.rejectedValue,observer.terminal=true,true
  delivered<-false;return nil
 });observer.rejectedOwned=true
 if err:=offlineNativePromiseThen(observer.promise,observer.resolved,observer.rejected);err!=nil {
  t.Fatal("HELD: native Promise observation unknown; quarantined observer cell retains both callbacks")
 }
 if valid:=<-delivered;!valid {
  t.Fatal("native Promise did not deliver a complete valid native inventory; observer cell remains quarantined")
 }
 // Do not retire from delivered, callbacks==0, or a Go done signal. None proves
 // the outer callback returned to JavaScript. Until the same-production path
 // supplies an actual return receipt, this future profile must fail as HELD.
 t.Fatal("HELD: complete native inventory delivered, but actual callback-wrapper return is unobserved; observer cell remains charged/quarantined")
}

func TestOfflineNativeUnusedFrameRejectsNativeRetargetAndIgnoresOwnSource(t *testing.T) {
 if !offlineNativeReady() {t.Fatal("native-browser precondition: actual startup native capture missing")}
 g:=js.Global()
 parent,err:=offlineNativeCaptureParent(g,checkedJSGet(g,"document"))
 if err!=nil {t.Fatal("native-browser precondition: actual controlled native parent missing")}
 object:=checkedJSGet(g,"Object")
 getterDescriptor:=checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSGet(object,"getOwnPropertyDescriptor"),checkedJSGet(checkedJSGet(g,"ServiceWorker"),"prototype"),"scriptURL")
 workerURL:=checkedJSApply(checkedJSGet(getterDescriptor,"get"),parent.Controller,checkedJSArray(nil)).String()
 helperURL:=parent.Origin+"/_native-unused-helper"
 for _,retarget:=range []bool{false,true} {t.Run(map[bool]string{false:"known unused",true:"native retarget"}[retarget],func(t *testing.T){
  frame,err:=offlineNativeCreateFrame(parent.Document,helperURL);if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  getterCalls:=0
  source:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{getterCalls++;return helperURL})
  defer source.Release()
  checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSReflection.defineProperty,frame,"src",checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"get":source,"configurable":true}))
  defer checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSGet(checkedJSGet(g,"Reflect"),"deleteProperty"),frame,"src")
  authCalls:=0
  var call *offlineNativeCall
  authorize:=js.FuncOf(func(_ js.Value,args []js.Value)any{authCalls++;return call!=nil && len(args)==3 && args[2].Equal(call.ReceiptIdentity())})
  defer authorize.Release()
  input:=offlineNativeInput{Operation:offlineNativeRetireNeverConnected,Nonce:"native-unused-src",Authorize:authorize,
   Refs:offlineNativeRefs{ParentWindow:parent.Window,ParentDocument:parent.Document,ParentNavigator:parent.Navigator,ParentContainer:parent.Container,ParentController:parent.Controller,ParentLocation:parent.Location,Frame:frame,Host:parent.Root},
   Policy:offlineNativePolicy{Origin:parent.Origin,HelperURL:helperURL,WorkerURL:workerURL,Scope:parent.Origin+"/"},
  }
  call,err=offlineNativePrepare(input);if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  if retarget {
   setDescriptor:=checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSGet(object,"getOwnPropertyDescriptor"),checkedJSGet(checkedJSGet(g,"Element"),"prototype"),"setAttribute")
   checkedJSApply(checkedJSGet(setDescriptor,"value"),frame,checkedJSArray([]any{"src",parent.Origin+"/_native-retargeted"}))
  }
  receipt,err:=call.Invoke(authorize)
  if err!=nil || !receipt.Entered || receipt.Issued || authCalls!=1 || getterCalls!=0 {t.Fatalf("physical native proof: %+v %v",receipt,err)}
  if retarget {
   if receipt.Reason!=offlineNativeReasonFrameRefused || receipt.Returned {t.Fatal("native source mismatch was accepted")}
  } else if receipt.Reason!=offlineNativeReasonNone || !receipt.Returned {t.Fatal("known unused node incorrectly required child/native removal")}
 })}
}
